evidence_items.explanation: The authors limit their lower bounds to calibrated prediction of particular facts and discuss mitigation through post-training. This blocks treating their theorem as proof of a universal architectural impossibility, but does not demonstrate a complete solution.

The paper develops statistical uncertainty estimation to detect confabulations, a subset of hallucinations. It provides a principled partial method, making the meaning of solution consequential, without establishing general elimination.
